notes.title: 2.02 Critical Patch
notes.content:
AI CHASER STABILITY FIX (CRITICAL PATCH)
Replaced Event Tick with Timer-Based FakeTick in the AI Controller to reduce unnecessary CPU load and ensure consistent behavior across all hardware.

Added IsValid safety checks throughout the AI Controller and Behavior Tree Tasks:

Player references and pawn targets are now validated before access.

Prevents Accessed None crashes caused by perception of destroyed or unloaded actors.

Removed deprecated Trace by Channel damage logic, which was improperly targeting outdated damage interfaces and causing sporadic crashes on certain systems.

Cleaned up MoveTo Player and Frozen State BTTasks to fail gracefully when their targets are invalid, instead of crashing or locking behavior trees.

notes.title: The Wickie 2.0 Has Arrived – Rebuilt. Revoiced. Reawakened.
notes.content:
🕯️ The Wickie 2.0 Has Arrived – Rebuilt. Revoiced. Reawakened.
Now Steam Deck compatible. DLSS / FSR / Native Upscaling supported.

"Pandora’s Rock is not what it was. The salt is deeper in the stone.
The machines have begun to speak again, and the ghosts now come with names."

After months of intense rebuilding, Version 2.0 of The Wickie is here—and it's not just a patch. It's a full resurrection.

What was once a mysterious curiosity has now become a fully voiced, fully 3D narrative horror experience with vast new areas, fresh systems, reworked environments, and a deeply atmospheric story flow.

🔥 Key Features in 2.0

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40176918/e9c29a7741d58a4126a2b04dd4bd7d7dbcf29609.png[/img]

🎮 Steam Deck Ready + Performance Improvements
FSR support for Steam Deck users ✅

DLSS support for NVIDIA users ✅

Native Upscaling support for everyone else ✅

Major performance optimizations across the board—expect smoother framerates and shorter load times.

🧍 All NPCs Are Now Fully 3D

Hand-animated with body language and facial nuance

Fully voiced with cinematic framing

Every interaction now feels alive, immersive, and eerie

🛳 Brand New Tutorial – Aboard The Wanderer

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40176918/8759778253b6bcb798aeb058fba7c3474e281717.png[/img]

Replaces the old skip-friendly version

Atmospheric intro level introduces lore, puzzle mechanics, and character tone

A strange, beautiful prelude to the horrors ahead

🏭 Massive New Zones & Reworks

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40176918/0afa57e412dd63f97bac3b5bf13fcdebdc454874.png[/img]

Cargo Sorting Station: Binary puzzle systems, stealth gameplay, and hostile C.A.R.L. units

Unit 4: An industrial tomb filled with rust, machinery, and deadly AI

Engine Room Igniter: Non-linear puzzle chains with narrative voiceovers and a terrifying new threat

The Bridge Spar: Meet Captain Malin in full

Asylum Rock Reception: Bureaucratic horror, new puzzles, and Tom Crilley’s unforgettable tannoy broadcasts

🌧 Weather & Lighting Overhaul

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40176918/aebd074b64e9ae3590b711251db0326815331bd6.png[/img]

Real-time puddles, stormfronts, fog layering, snowfall and wet surfaces

Each zone now breathes and reacts to your presence

🧠 The World Has Grown Strange
Everything from the UI to the save system has been rethought for immersion and tone. There are new ways to move, new ways to die, and new ways to understand what’s truly happening on Pandora’s Rock.

📘 Patch Notes (Optional Reading – But Deep Lore Fans, This is For You) are available in the community hub!

notes.title: Build 1.2.4 "Maps (They don't love you like I do)" is now LIVE.
notes.content:
CHANGES.
=========

MAP
-----
New Feature - The Main Map.  You can now see where you are in the world by opening the Map (currently pressing M which is remappable to a game console button!).  You can view where you are and where to go on the main islands - Gondola, Asylum Rock and Pandora's Rock now and the map dynamically switches between each.

MAP MARKERS
----------------
NPCs and interesting items and things are now marked on your main map and also on the new minimap for you.  Some items and markers will ONLY appear on the minimap so that you can locate hard to find items when you are near them.

MINIMAP
----------
The minimap is now open all the time showing where you are, what you are near and which direction you are facing!  

MAP NAVIGATION
-------------------
Need to get somewhere?  Right click in the main map to set a marker and then just GO!  Note that the directions given may be dangerous or outright wrong.  That is because it deliberately has no idea of the secret passages and so on.

MOBS AND NAVI.
-------------------
Mapwide navigation for NPCs is now enabled.  Beware.  More mobs are incoming.  The "Oh its a gun" update will be coming soon.  Perhaps.

notes.title: The Wickie 1.2.2 - "Zelmire" Patch
notes.content:
PATCH NOTES.
============
This patch addresses serious issues when in conversation with Neville at the quay on Day 1 where a cyclical reference caused a CTD for some players.  This issue was investigated and the conversation tree modified in order to fix the dependency loop.  Thanks to player Zelmire for reporting the issue!

IN ADDITION.
===========
Streamer Octopink raised concerns that the upper walkways are difficult to navigate for some players with limited mobility or who are not good at timing jumps etc.  Because of this there are now some MAJOR changes to the Day 1 gameplay second half pipeline which will be propagated to day 2,3,4 and 5 this week after additional testing.

Change 1.
-----------
On exiting the upper engine room, you can continue to take the walkway or you can now step onto the transportation carts (Troy no doubt has a fancy name for them) which will take you on a crazy coaster ride down to the Pliades platform.  Again this is optional. 

Change 2.
-----------
If you have made your way up to the upper engine room and not put in the code correctly, rather than slowly climbing back down again, you can instead use Troy's prototype transportation device located in the room next to the generator.  This will prevent much frustration if you have not entered the code correctly.

Change 3.
-----------
SOMETIMES if you fall off a cliff and have saved and returned to a checkpoint between the upper engine room and the black gates, you may find that the engine room is shut down again meaning you have to walk back.  Not any more.  It turns out we never noticed Troy had built a large workshop where the gate lever was housed and on accessing it from the Engine Room you will find that it works just fine.

There are other changes, however that's your bob for now.

Cris R

notes.title: The Wickie - Patch 1.2.0 Changelog
notes.content:
[h1]The Wickie - Patch 1.2.0 Changelog[/h1]
[i]A Large Feature & Fix Patch[/i]

Greetings Keepers,

Patch 1.2.0 brings significant improvements, new features, and important fixes to The Wickie. This update refines core systems, expands on visual feedback for key mechanics, and resolves several player-reported issues.

[h2]Major Changes & Features[/h2]

[b]HUD Reticule Update[/b]
[list]
[] Following player feedback, the HUD reticule has been adjusted for improved visibility.
[] The reticule now remains larger even when not hovering over an interactive item, making it easier to see in all conditions.
[/list]

[b]Checkpoint & Save System Expansion[/b]
[list]
[] The visual steampunk-inspired save system, previously used from Days 2-5, has now been implemented in Day 1 as well.
[] Instead of the previous invisible checkpoint system, players will now encounter a [b]distinct, interactive save area[/b] that reacts when activated.
[*] A [b]small animated circle[/b] will now appear in the lower-right corner to indicate when a save is successfully registered.
[/list]

[h2]Fixes & Gameplay Improvements[/h2]

[b]Storeroom Security[/b]
[list]
[*] The [b]storeroom at the Quay has been relocked[/b] to prevent unintended access.
[/list]

[b]Sailor Conversations Repaired[/b]
[list]
[] Certain conversations among sailors previously referenced incorrect names—these have now been corrected.
[] The [b]two sailors talking on Gondola Island[/b] now play the appropriate dialogue, restoring narrative consistency.
[/list]

[b]Improved Water Exit on Gondola Island[/b]
[list]
[*] Players who fall into the water upon first arriving at Gondola Island will now find it [b]much easier to exit[/b], thanks to a [b]newly added stairway[/b].
[/list]

[b]New Conversations Added for Clarity[/b]
[list]
[*] [b]Neil at the Engine Rooms[/b] now has additional dialogue to better explain the purpose of the [b]steampunk save system[/b] and how it functions.
[/list]

[b]Keybinding System Fixed & Fully Functional[/b]
[list]
[] [b]Keybinding was previously non-functional[/b]—this has now been completely resolved.
[] Players can now [b]fully customize[/b] their key and gamepad bindings for movement and interactions.
[/list]

[b]New Mouse & Controller Customization Options[/b]
[list]
[] Players can now [b]adjust controller sensitivity[/b] for both mouse and gamepad via the Pause Menu.
[] [b]Mouse inversion is now fully supported[/b], providing more options for player preference.
[/list]

[h2]Versioning & Acknowledgments[/h2]

Due to the scale of this release, the game version has moved from [b]1.1.4 to 1.2.0[/b].

Special thanks to [b]Tony and Octopink[/b] for reporting these issues—your feedback has been invaluable in improving the experience for all players!

notes.title: The Wickie - 8pm GMT Tuesday the 4th of February.
notes.content:
After years of exploration through time, dimensions, and the fragility of reality itself, The Wickie is finally here on Tuesday the 4th of Feb at 8pm. The wait is soon over. Version 1.1 introduces a sprawling, mysterious island where secrets lie in every shadow. Explore hidden, undocumented areas that will shift your perception and introduce strange, dangerous creatures that have never been seen before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40176918/602baf9df536ce6d5370cb120c081df39ad765fc.jpg[/img]

This release brings you to the true vision of The Wickie—a deeply atmospheric first-person adventure that focuses on eerie exploration and mind-bending puzzles, not on combat or cheap scares. Every step you take on this island is a descent into madness, blending Lovecraftian dread with Lynchian oddities. The boundaries of time, space, and sanity blur as you uncover the island’s most sinister mysteries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40176918/e0996276ba20f45d46a721d27901d41e72778648.jpg[/img]

It's not just a game. It’s an experience—one that will leave you questioning what’s real, what’s illusion, and what waits beyond the veil. The Wickie is now more than just a haunting journey; it's a reflection of your deepest fears and curiosity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40176918/9b69c92594ab5f2db6afdb8a61a4c3e82873e284.jpg[/img]

Are you ready to uncover the island’s secrets? To navigate its hidden corners, confront its horrors, and challenge your understanding of what you thought was possible?

The Wickie is waiting. Step onto the shore and discover your fate.

notes.title: The Wickie is Coming!
notes.content:
Its been four years of hard work bringing The Wickie to life, however I am very glad to be able to at last tell you that The Wickie is ready for release and will be coming out in December this year.  Featuring several explorable islands, this open world horror adventure will bring delight to any lover of cosmic horror with a firm focus on exploration, puzzle solving and surviving against the harsh environmental hazards on Pandora's Rock.  
[previewyoutube=HRvZK1qdfZc;full][/previewyoutube]
So, keep your eyes peeled, I will be posting more media and the official trailer for the game is due out in just a few days!

notes.title: Version 0.8.3 - Closed Beta Version Information (possible spoilers)
notes.content:
Version 0.8.3 - Patch Notes

Release Date: June 2024

Highlights:

Day 1 & Day 2 Completion: These levels are now fully playable, providing a solid foundation for new and returning players.
Day 3, 4, and 5: These levels are near completion with minor tweaks and narrative elements for NPCs pending, and anticipated to be finalized within two months.
New Observatory Area: The under-observatory areas, including labs and study zones for Troy's projects, offer a vast pipeline passageway providing an alternate route through the island, bypassing the Smugglers Run section.
Dialogue & Humor: New dialogue options enhance the storyline with humour, particularly through interactions with Peter De Bole and the evolving character of Troy Malin.
Engine Upgrade: Upgraded the game engine from Unreal Engine 5.2.1 to Unreal Engine 5.4.1, significantly enhancing visual fidelity, performance, and stability.
Technical Improvements:

DLSS Update: Integrated and optimized DLSS, delivering an average of 80FPS on high detail at 1080p and stable performance at 4k, although not fully optimized.
Sound Adjustments: Ambient sounds have been refined to enrich the game’s atmosphere.
Engine Upgrade: The game has been upgraded to Unreal Engine 5.4.1, moving from 5.2.1. Originally, the game started development on Unreal Engine 4.11.0.
Gameplay Enhancements:

Easter Eggs & Hidden Items: Added new easter eggs and hidden items to discover, increasing engagement and replayability.
Cosmetic Upgrades: Essential visual enhancements have been implemented to elevate the overall gaming experience.
Narrative Progress:

Character Development: Continued development of Troy Malin’s character, adding depth and humor to the narrative.
Day 3 Narrative: The narrative for Day 3 involves Bill investigating a missing necklace with esoteric powers, critical to the Marsh family's operations.
Upcoming Features:

Radio Station for Day 2: Pending further development, expected to be integrated after a dedicated weekend of work.

notes.title: Version 0.8.2.4 - Patch Notes
notes.content:
Version 0.8.2.4 - Patch Notes

Release Date: Sunday, May 19th, 2024

Patch Highlights:

Critical enhancements to the quest system and save/load functionality for improved playability.
Details:

Quest System Overhaul:

The quest system now provides end-to-end guidance for players from the start to the end of each day, ensuring clear objectives and smoother progression.
Quests are now integrated with the overall save system, allowing players to save and load their progress without losing active or completed quests. This ensures continuity and prevents the loss of progress.
Save/Load Functionality:

Although marked for future upgrades, the current save and load system is now functional and reliable, supporting the newly integrated quest system.
Players can now save their game at any point and resume from where they left off, with all quest data intact.
Quest Tracking for Keyboard Users:

For keyboard users, pressing the / key on the numpad will bring up a list of active and completed quests.
This feature is a temporary solution for quest tracking, with plans for easier access and more intuitive UI in the next save/load system update.
Tester Notes:

This update is critical for enhancing playability and ensuring players know their objectives and how to achieve them.
Feedback on the functionality of the quest system and the save/load integration is crucial. Please report any issues or suggestions for improvement.

notes.title: 0.8.2.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Version 0.8.2.3 - Patch Notes

Release Date: Wednesday, May 15th, 2024

Patch Highlights:

Enhanced NPC positioning to eliminate clipping issues.
Spelling corrections in dialogue to improve narrative quality.
Accessibility improvements and aesthetic enhancements across various game locations.
Details:

NPC Position Adjustments:

Fixed issues where various NPCs were either floating or embedded in the ground, ensuring all characters interact with the environment realistically.
Dialogue Improvements:

Corrected spelling errors across multiple dialogue scripts, enhancing clarity and immersion in the game's storytelling.
Gondola Island Gantryway:

Fixed the rear gantryway and removed a large obstacle that hindered access to the secret teleport area.
Secret Teleport Area:

Introduced a key accessible to players upon completing a side quest on Gondola Island. The teleport area door is now locked, adding a layer of challenge and intrigue.
Visual Enhancements:

Added new foliage on the long stairs at Pandora's Rock island to enhance visual appeal.
Erected new structures next to the esoteric gateway on Pandora's Rock, integrating it more seamlessly with the surrounding environment and addressing gaps in the scenery.
Spider Mechanic Adjustments:

Repositioned the spider in the engine room tunnels to address previous functionality issues.
Simplified the floor of the spider chamber and filled in holes to prevent player and NPC mishaps.
Tutorial Puzzle Feedback:

The tutorial puzzle involving moving a skull into a waste basket now provides player feedback upon completion, indicating that an NPC area door is unlocked.
Tester Feedback Request:

We particularly value feedback on the new positioning of the spider and the functionality of the secret teleport area. Please report any irregularities or suggestions for further refinements.

notes.title: Version 0.8.2.2 - Patch Notes

Extensive environmental and structural fixes to enhance game flow and aesthetics.
Continued focus on refining gameplay mechanics and the player's explorative experience.

Environmental Adjustments:

Keepers Station Area: Removed a large floating area caused by procedural generation artifacts. The area is now seamlessly integrated with the surrounding environment.

Walkway Between Engine Rooms 2 and 3: Fixed landscape issues that caused a blockage, smoothing out the area for better navigation.
Observatory: Corrected the issue of floating flowers, ensuring they now properly interact with the terrain.
Engine Room Pathway: Updated the final stage of the engine room path with interesting geometry to fill previously empty spaces, enhancing visual interest and playability.
Approach to the Keeper’s Station: The barren area en route has been lushly planted and now features minor new structures, enriching the visual and explorative elements of the game.
Accessibility Enhancements:

Tunnel Access Beneath the Keeper’s Station: Reinstated access to the tunnel directly underneath the keeper's station, including entrances that had been previously considered for removal.
Ongoing Issues and Tweaks:

Spider Caves: Ongoing adjustments are needed for the aesthetics and functionality of the spider caves. Pathfinding issues with the spider are still being addressed to enhance NPC behavior.
Note to Testers:

Your feedback on these fixes is invaluable, especially concerning the pathfinding issues in the spider caves. Please report any discrepancies or suggestions for further enhancements.

The Wickie is now at 0.8.0 for its version, which may not mean a lot to the layman out there, however it marks a massive step in The Wickie : Shadows Over Islolation's march towards a release this year.  While it may sound technical as a number, it represents a major leap from the early days, bringing me closer to delivering a complete gaming experience.

There are all areas not buildings, explorable and large and make up a huge part of the game too.  The completion of the 0.7.X versions means I am now happy with the world sandbox that you have to explore and play in and that it is time to make sure that you have fun doing so!

At the moment the focus of the 8.0+ releases is on quest management and dialogue which is there but needs a but of tightening and tuning.  Future focus is also on splitting the days into their own containers to make gameplay more interesting and exciting!

Ideas tried and abandoned for being silly (aww) are;

Huuuuuuge building with swimming pool, ballroom etc.  Generally even though it was awesome, it was not needed at all and was a time sink.

Steampunk air vehicles.  Utterly awesome but ruined the serious parts of the game with too much whimsy.

Daily Watch.  Reduced to just a few occasions so that the player can focus on the adventure without getting bogged down with the details of Lighthouse Keeping.  Eventually a full lighthouse keeper game will be added once the ENTIRE project is complete with all free DLC being a part of the project.  

Picnic at Pandora's Rock.  Delayed but coming eventually.  

Much love and FEEL FREE to ask questions!

Cris

notes.title: The Wickie Update 0.7.4
notes.content:
The Wickie Update 0.7.4

Greetings,

We are pleased to announce the release of Update 0.7.4 for "The Wickie". This update marks significant advancements in game content, optimization, and player interaction mechanics. Please find the details of the changes included in this patch below.

New Content:

Day 4 Expansion: The introduction of Day 4 includes fully explorable new areas complete with unique environmental storytelling elements, engaging puzzles, and lore-rich scenarios. Players can now uncover the mysteries of the Lower Broch Fortifications, the Vast (non) Submerged Daolithc area, Valve Caracalla, and more.

Entity Development: We have integrated a new cosmic entity, Daolithc, into the game narrative. Daolithc offers a complex character design aligned with the overarching cosmic horror theme, presenting both a visual and narrative enhancement to the game world.

Optimizations:

Performance Enhancements: Significant optimizations have been implemented to improve game speed and maintain consistent frame rates across all supported hardware, ensuring a smoother gameplay experience.
Gameplay Improvements:

NPC Interaction: We have revisited the NPC interaction system, reverting to the 'click to interact' method to provide a more intuitive and responsive player experience.
Upcoming Work:

Interaction System Update: Later this week, we plan to roll out further improvements to the NPC interaction system to address current issues and enhance overall game responsiveness.
We are dedicated to continuously improving "The Wickie" and appreciate your feedback and support. Thank you for joining us on this eerie adventure.

notes.title: The Wickie 0.7 Update - A Glimpse into Pandora's Rock
notes.content:
[h1]Press Release: The Wickie 0.7  - A Journey Through Time, Mystery, and Innovation[/h1]

[h2][Summary][/h2]

"The Wickie," a visually stunning and deeply immersive adventure game, is slated for release in April 2024. This marks the end of a remarkable four-year development journey by Cris Robson, a passionate and dedicated game developer. Built on [b]Unreal Engine 5.2.3[/b], the game employs groundbreaking technologies like [i]Lumen[/i] and [i]Nanite[/i] to deliver an unmatched level of realism and visual fidelity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40176918/2f5ec9dd6a79ed7e77d7a8aecb6aa1cbf3650cb7.png[/img]

[h2][Body][/h2]

In "The Wickie," players are transported to [b]Pandora's Rock[/b], a mysterious island filled with secrets, supernatural occurrences, and an incredibly rich environment. The game spans an intense five days of in-game time, packed with complex missions and captivating storylines.

The latest [b]0.7 beta release[/b] is the most robust yet, featuring state-of-the-art global illumination and detailed environments for an immersive gaming experience. Smooth gameplay is guaranteed on platforms like [i]Steamdeck[/i], although 4K resolution demands a more robust system.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40176918/320ec884ae8061cf81b128b3a6441d332a69f566.png[/img]

Unique to "The Wickie" is its commitment to free lifetime updates, allowing the game to evolve and grow based on player interactions. This player-centric development approach sets the game apart from traditional DLC models.

The game's narrative is a rich tapestry of history, myth, and technology, offering players a diverse and engaging experience. From encountering ghosts and mysterious creatures to solving intricate puzzles, "The Wickie" promises a journey full of discovery and intrigue.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40176918/946b42bbcf255696a9687575890d4479ae39ec23.png[/img]

The game world is a masterpiece of design, with a new water system that produces realistic waves and a beautifully crafted natural landscape. Key features include the lighthouse keeper mini-game, which adds a layer of complexity and realism to the gameplay.

[h2][About the Developer][/h2]

"The Wickie" is the brainchild of Cris Robson, a 52-year-old game developer with Autism and Cerebral Palsy. Cris's journey in game development is a story of passion, resilience, and creativity. Despite facing challenges, his commitment to bringing "The Wickie" to life has been unwavering. This project is more than a game; it's a reflection of Cris's dedication to his craft and his desire to create an experience that resonates with players on multiple levels.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40176918/b0590ed8ec977a0bc10ed0d55f90d803526ec20c.png[/img]

Cris's approach to game development is deeply personal, infusing "The Wickie" with a unique perspective that enriches the gaming experience. His journey is an inspiring testament to the power of determination and the endless possibilities within the realm of independent game development.

notes.title: Explore the Dark Mysteries of Pandora's Rock: The Wickie Beta v0.5.1 Unveiled!
notes.content:
The Wickie - Version 0.5.1 Beta Release Notes
New Features:

[list]
[*] Lighthouse Keeper Jobs: Engage in the daily duties of a lighthouse keeper, including maintaining the beacon, watching for ships, and operating the foghorn.
[*] Dynamic Ship System: Ships now travel around the island, responding to the lighthouse signals and weather conditions.
[*] Procedural Landscape Evolution: Leveraging the latest procedural generation techniques in Unreal Engine, we've crafted a living, breathing environment where the rocky outcrops and terrain of Pandora's Rock evolve with each playthrough. This cutting-edge technology infuses our indie game with a level of detail and dynamism traditionally reserved for AAA titles, ensuring that every journey through the island is as unique as it is mesmerizing.
[*] NPC Interaction Upgrades: Enhanced dialogue trees and interactions with key characters like Captain Malin and the sailor family.
[*] Occult Research Mechanic: Delve into the mysteries of the island with a new research system that allows you to uncover hidden lore and secrets.
[*] Weather and Time System: Experience the atmospheric changes of Pandora's Rock with a dynamic weather system.
[*] Expanded Open World: Explore more of Pandora's Rock with additional areas unlocked and detailed for exploration.
[*] Meet Dougie: A New Face on Asylum Rock: A fresh narrative unfolds with Dougie, the latest addition to the enigmatic cast of characters. Stationed at Asylum Rock, Dougie's story is interwoven with the island's many secrets, offering new quests and insights into the dark past of this forsaken place.
[*] Beware the Shadows: The Legend of 'Bob the Burninator': Whispers of a lurking presence have begun to stir among the island's inhabitants. Known only as 'Bob the Burninator' in the hushed tales of the old sailors, this enigmatic force casts a new shadow over Pandora's Rock. Will you uncover the truth behind the legend, or will you be consumed by the island's newest mystery?
[/list]

Improvements:

[list]
[*] AI Pathfinding: Improved navigation for NPCs, ensuring smoother movement and interactions within the game world.
[*] Visual Enhancements: Upgraded textures and lighting for a more immersive experience, powered by Unreal Engine 5.1.
[*] Audio Overhaul: New soundscapes and effects that bring the eerie atmosphere of the island to life.
[*] Performance Optimization: Adjustments made to texture sizes and shadow depths to improve frame rates and overall game performance.
[/list]

Bug Fixes:

Addressed an issue where the gondola lift would not properly load and unload assets, resulting in visual pop-in/out.
Fixed a bug where the lighthouse lamp timer would not sync with the beacon switches correctly.
Resolved various collision issues that allowed players to access unintended areas.
Known Issues:

Some players have reported intermittent issues with the foghorn recharge mechanic.
Occasional clipping during NPC interactions is being investigated.
Work is ongoing to resolve minor UI inconsistencies in the occult research interface.

notes.title: Meet Dougie: The Newest Face on Pandora's Rock!
notes.content:
Dougie isn't just any character; he's a testament to the evolving world of The Wickie and the magic of game development. With his rugged appearance and intriguing backstory, Dougie promises to add another layer of depth to the already rich tapestry of our game's narrative.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40176918/38cc6a4c166f81c57f47c06237d3b0dbc3fb0262.png[/img]

The inception of Dougie is a tale of creativity and serendipity. Originally, we had a different design for another character named Peter. However, as the game evolved, so did our vision for Peter. This left us with some captivating artwork by the talented LadyPlantPots. Instead of letting such a brilliant design go to waste, we breathed life into it, and thus, Dougie was born!

We're eager to hear your thoughts! How do you think Dougie will fit into the mysteries of Pandora's Rock? Share your speculations and excitement with us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40176918/ef92864f9618e2b45070976202f3cbc5d8e90f8d.jpg[/img]

Stay tuned as we continue to unveil more surprises, characters, and tales from The Wickie. The world of Pandora's Rock is ever-expanding, and we can't wait for you to dive deeper into its mysteries.

If you're as excited about Dougie as we are, make sure to wishlist The Wickie on Steam and share this announcement with fellow explorers!

Thank you for being a part of this journey with us. Your support and enthusiasm fuel our creativity. Here's to many more adventures together!

notes.title: Venturing into the Depths: New Atmospheric Areas Unveiled in The Wickie
notes.content:
Today, we are thrilled to offer a glimpse into the enigmatic depths that lie beneath the island. These newly unveiled atmospheric areas are not for the faint of heart, as they introduce an otherworldly, Lovecraftian environment teeming with ancient horrors and uncanny mysteries.

As you descend into the darkness, you'll find that these subterranean realms challenge your very sanity. The architecture itself seems to defy logic, with seemingly impossible angles and disorienting layouts. The very air is thick with an unsettling ambiance that leaves you questioning your senses.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40176918/de027369c80f05aa99dc158f857755660053a3f1.png[/img]

These depths are illuminated by the eerie glow of strange, wet-looking crystals. While their origin and purpose remain a mystery, they cast an unsettling light upon the twisted creatures that lurk in the shadows. One such creature is the Shambler – an ancient horror whose mere presence sends shivers down your spine. It is unclear why this monstrous being resides in the depths, but its existence is a testament to the unfathomable secrets hidden beneath the island.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40176918/a109e53af986e778e4de9eb81aff80bb17339542.png[/img]

As you navigate these treacherous areas, you'll need to rely on your wits and common sense. Bill, our intrepid protagonist, has the choice to either confront the menacing creatures head-on or attempt a more stealthy approach, avoiding combat altogether. However, it is essential to remember that these nightmarish beings are not easily defeated – if they can be vanquished at all.

The Wickie's new atmospheric areas are designed to challenge and intrigue players, drawing them into the depths of a world beyond their wildest imagination. With a myriad of possible paths, the choices you make will ultimately determine Bill's fate. Will you choose to confront the darkness, or will you seek to evade the horrors that dwell beneath the island's surface?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40176918/300bbe3edddd68302979beef210fa70dd40d44e3.png[/img]

As you venture further into this Lovecraftian nightmare, you'll uncover hidden secrets and unravel the enigmatic history of the island and its terrifying inhabitants. But beware – for with each step you take into the abyss, the line between reality and madness becomes increasingly blurred.

We invite you to join us on this harrowing journey into the unknown. The Wickie's new atmospheric areas promise a gaming experience like no other, where the darkness will envelop you, and the twisted creatures of the deep will haunt your every step.

Prepare yourself to venture into the depths of The Wickie, where ancient horrors lurk, and the truth is more terrifying than you could ever imagine.

Stay tuned for more updates, and don't forget to wishlist The Wickie on Steam to stay informed on the latest news on this upcoming title!

notes.title: Pre-Release Feb Update (Major) now live for testers.
notes.content:
The Wickie: Latest Release Notes Feb 14th Version Now Available for Playtesting

Gamers and adventure enthusiasts alike can now experience the latest version of The Wickie, which is available for playtesting. This version includes new experimental features that have yet to be fully documented.

In an effort to streamline gameplay, the option to play guitar has been removed from the game. The developers found that it added little to the game and did not contribute to the overall story.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40176918/ac89ceea63f8c2f10405147bbfcce4aa8cf3862f.png[/img]

However, players can still discover guitar-playing areas in the game, hidden as Easter eggs for those who seek them out.

The game's standard levels include Day 1 Introduction, Day 1, Dreams 1, NES 1, Day 2, and Books. Some of the books in the game are readable, and players can pick them up and store them, dropping them as needed. Players can only carry one book at a time, so strategic decision-making is required.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40176918/c379fe71371fd25369fea2f832d098754ab09bf4.png[/img]

The game encourages players to explore and follow clues, but be wary of pitfalls and traps along the way. The island changes and morphs throughout the game, reflecting the mental state of the main character.

As the game is still under development, players can expect to encounter bugs or glitches, which will be addressed through regular patches and updates.

The Wickie offers an immersive and challenging gaming experience that will test players' wits and perseverance. Are you brave enough to explore the secrets of the island? Play The Wickie and find out!

For more information and to apply to test out the latest version of The Wickie, please visit

notes.title: Live Streaming The Wickie; Journey of a Lighthouse Keeper NEW Demo
notes.content:
Is it human or monster? Discover a dark secret in this open-world first-person adventure game.
There is a secret on the Islands, that you must uncover, and it is up to you to find out what it is. Are you BRAVE enough to explore the secrets of the islands? Are you DARING enough to survive two weeks in one of the most remote places on Earth?

[previewyoutube=wVO9GS6S64w;full][/previewyoutube]

Encounter sinister characters, strange and unnerving new people, strange and esoteric places, and weird phenomena in this twisted fable.
A foreboding, imposing place of outstanding natural beauty that has been paired with otherworldly buildings, impenetrable isolation, and tantalizing mystery. In this disconcerting adventure, how will your story evolve? Will you take the easy options or explore and experience ancient cosmic terrors?
This place has a rich history, full of hidden secrets, and it will be up to you to explore and find them. You must uncover the dark past that has shaped this island and find out what lies within. But beware, for there are many dangers lurking in these strange and forbidden islands...

Cris Robson, the developer of the game will be broadcasting the demo live on Steam NextFest and will be happy to answer questions. The Demo of The Wickie; Journey of a Lighthouse Keeper, is set on the first day that you arrive on the island and your first foray into learning your way around. You will meet new people and visit new places as you solve a small puzzle or two and start to take note of what is going on. While the entire island can be explored, Cris will not be taking you too far into it's secrets during the broadcast, as some secrets are best discovered for yourselves...

And others... should stay hidden...

notes.title: The New Trailer For The WIckie; Journey of a Lighthouse Keeper Out Now.
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=wVO9GS6S64w;full][/previewyoutube]

In The Wickie; Journey of a lighthouse keeper, you journey to Pandora’s Rock, an island in the Outer Hebrides, to take up duty as a lighthouse keeper back in 1936.
Over a two-week period, you will perform the duties of a lighthouse keeper, while also uncovering mystery and adventure in this multi-layered isolated, magical, and mysterious yet breathtakingly beautiful remote Scottish paradise.

Pandora’s Rock is 4km square, inhabited by beautiful local flora and fauna. An abandoned village and community lies on the western shore near the old quay, while to the east a large broch stands forboding.  Mysterious standing stones on the southwest peninsula lead past esoteric statues, the origins of which are long lost.

You will come across unusual characters on your journey.  Uncover strange pasts, and hidden secrets and obtain the trust of those who might be able to help you. But be wary.  Is there something more going on under the surface?  Talk to people, get clues, solve puzzles and find out more as you interact with your environment in fully realized open world 3d.

The Summoning : Amanda Robson

The game releases October 2022 and in the meantime, keep your eyes open for the demo, coming in June!

Cris

I promised new images and new video - if you go to the Steam store page for The Wickie you will see that all images and videos are replaced now in the preview area - I will add some more once the major updates are done over the festive season and I will be keeping you posted at all times. I must apologise for not posting frequently about this. As a solo developer, my hours are long and full and unfortunately I have been very busy and unable to keep up with update posting - I aim to get into a better routine of this as of now.  

If you enjoyed the demos then THANKYOU.  Seriously, I am massively grateful you took the time to try them out.  I am working on building the game that I want to play, which means there is a lot of work to do in order to get it all working but I promise there will be a new demo soon!

Finally - I am going to rip the band aid off, and move the game from being early access to being a full version release next year.  I do not want people to think they are taking a risk on something that is woefully unfinished, so after some thinking it has been decided that I will instead ship a full release and then go straight into addons and patches following release of the game.  Hopefully that will make the game better for all of you and at the same time, prove my commitment to making a working and fun game!

So have a great festive season, be lovely to each other, pet your shoggoth and I will keep on working on The Wickie!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40176918/dfbe3a680fc7ba0ea65aac70bca6a57c20eb6dfe.png[/img]

Much love!

Cris

notes.title: The Wickie Public Demo Version 2 is Now Available!
notes.content:
Originally released mid June 2021, The Wickie Demo version 1 was a fun journey fron Goldola Island through to Pandora's Rock with the aim of finding Captain Malin so that you can report for duty as a probationary lighthouse keeper.  

The new demo releases right now, and with this demo comes a lot of new features that finally made it into the game as well as a lot more content for you to discover and try out for yourself.  Some of the new content is available right now, with some bonus material to be released into the live version of the demo over the next few weeks.  

New Things.
1.  Find them yourself.  That's kind of the point.

Trivia and Interesting Things

Did you try the original version 0.1? That was the only version where you could actually ride The Wanderer, back before Gondola Island was created to act as a platform into Pandora's Island.  All tthe puzzles took place upon the ship and the demo ended when you got to the main island before the boat docked.  It had full narration, which was cut because honestly I was sick of the sound of my own voice.  Thank god for Rob Sharp (Capt Malin), at least he knows how to talk properly!

The lighthouse was originally a tower lighthouse.  Tower lighthouses are the ones that stand on their own without an island and the game was going to explore the idea of being a lighthouse keeper more as a simulation.

notes.title: The Wickie Day 0 - Show n Tell!
notes.content:
Do you love thrillers and horror?  Come with Cris at CGPirates as he walks you through some of the demos, stopping to talk about influences, discuss what is in the main game and talk about some of the earlier versions of the demo that never made it to release.

If you love Lovecraft and crave Cthulhu mythos then, hopefully, this is for you!  A non-combat-focused adventure game presented first-person 3D using AAA assets, developed by someone with a passion for his project!

A Wickie is a nickname for a lighthouse keeper.  As a newly recruited Wickie (with a past...) it is your job to go to Pandora's Rock in the Outer Hebrides and learn the ropes from experienced lighthouse keeper Captain Malin.  A dangerous job, a demanding job, and one that will put strains on your mind.

In this first pre-chapter of the game, you are headed to the island.  You missed your connection and you have to use the old pleasure gondola that closed some 20 years ago instead.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40176918/3a3bb116e06123673e154e8b993f24dfead10e2e.jpg[/img]#

[list]
[*] Why do the people look so strange?
[*] Why do people go missing?
[*] What are those strange noises from the old village?
[/list]

You can answer these questions if you investigate.  However, you can also choose not to investigate and see how that goes instead.  The Wickie is an open-world game set over two weeks with multiple stories, multiple endings, and a wealth of secrets to find or avoid.  You can and probably will go insane.  If you are not insane already of course...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40176918/76f8fecbf49c8da749a35939438e7454d455c886.jpg[/img]

There are monsters out there.  Feel free to come to the event and ask questions - just do not expect answers!

notes.title: The Wickie - Welcome to The Rock
notes.content:
The developer Cris will be taking you on a guided tour of the Island of Pandora's Rock (The Rock), showing historical features, giving small clues and also talking about some of the various options for play that are available on the island of The 'Rock.

During the event, your tour guide Cris will take you from the landing Quay up to the main house, stopping by the observatory on the way.  After a brief rest in the main house, a quick walk past the ancient standing stones and down to the old village to talk about the real influences behind the game to wrap up what we hope is a beautiful afternoon out.  See the wildlife roaming the island, as its ecosystem brings it all to life!  

Cris is a seasoned developer, having worked in the industry for over 20 years as a developer, consultant, and trainer to the 3d industry, and has worked with very major clients over those years.  The Wickie is a culmination of his skills and experiences, with the aim of bringing a 'slow burn' Lovecraftian style Thriller to the computer/console screen.  Using photogrammetry scanned assets, lovingly hand created AAA grade game assets and especially commissioned traditional art, The Wickie is a large open-world game where you can explore above, below and inside the island in your quests to either just do your job or to explore and find out what is REALLY going on.

With a range of real choices and paths that you can take as you play the game, you can decide if you are going to just let what is occuring happen, or you can try and fight against the coming horrors and madness.  As you go further behind what is happening, you will get more involved with bizzare adventures of terror, madness and strange tidings!  

The Wickie is a Thriller / Lovecraftian Horror game based on an island far off the coast of Western Scotland in 1936.  War is on the horizon again, and you are a young probationary lighthouse keeper (wickie), assigned to work the most remote lighthouse in the country.  
With you for company is an old salt, Captain Malin - wise and able to show you the ropes - and Jack Cromarty, an American and somewhat aloof character.  As the main protagonist, Bill Fisher, your job is to learn the ropes and keep that light bright and shining.  Perhaps there is more going on than meets the eye?  Perhaps if you were to look a little deeper you will see what is going on under the surface?  Perhaps ... perhaps... perhaps...  
Will you take the hard, safe option?  Or the harder and much less safe option?  When you get to the end of your journey will you be quite mad?

notes.title: We are on Steam!
notes.content:
Our FIRST Steam Milestone!  We are so so happy to have made it to Steam!  I realise for a lot of people that you may not realise the importance of this goal however I personally have used Steam for over 10 years and it is so nice to see something I am working on, finally go on there! 

If you are a part of the community, I welcome you and I hope that you will become involved int he growth not only of our community but of the game as a whole through ideas, suggestions and participating in polls! 

The sleeper stirs...

Cris
